description: DevTools extensions for Roopik browser preview. Add unpacked Chrome DevTools extensions here.

howToAdd: 1. Download the extension from Chrome Web Store (use CRX Extractor)
2. Extract the .crx file (rename to .zip and unzip)
3. Create a folder with the extension name (e.g., 'react-devtools')
4. Copy the extracted contents into that folder
5. Add an entry to the 'extensions' array below

extensions.name: React Developer Tools
extensions.description: Inspect React component hierarchy, props, state, and hooks
